inputs.text: [frantic, overwhelmed, desperate, pleading to camera] There's GOT to be a better way!
[serene, blissed out, relaxed] I closed our biggest deal... from this hammock.

voice.name: Designed A
voice.about: An eager American software-startup founder in his late twenties in 1994. A slightly high, reedy voice, quick and frantic, cracking with stress, sincere and a bit nerdy. Clean studio microphone.
